invariants.statement: Remote default branch main must be protected by remote branch protection rulesets enforcing pull request reviews, status checks, and deletion/force-push prevention.
invariants.proof_requirement: GitHub API query against /branches/main/protection and /rulesets returning active enforcement configuration.
invariants.negative_control: Direct git push to origin/main rejected by remote pre-receive hook or branch rule.

invariants.statement: Every qualifying release must be bound to an immutable Git commit SHA witnessed by an external transparency log root.
invariants.proof_requirement: Rekor transparency log entry matching the release commit SHA and cryptographic signature.
invariants.negative_control: Unwitnessed release SHA rejected during pre-commit verification.

invariants.statement: The Gate-3 consumer workflow cannot self-authorize and must not have permissions to mint, sign, overwrite, supersede, or revoke its own authorization.
invariants.proof_requirement: Cloud IAM role policy validation verifying consumer has zero kms:Sign permissions and only read/verify access.
invariants.negative_control: Runner attempting to self-issue Gate-3 authorization rejected with ConsumerCannotSelfAuthorizeError.

invariants.statement: Gate-3 authorizations must possess single-use semantics; once claimed, an authorization cannot be claimed again or replayed.
invariants.proof_requirement: Linearizable CAS claim in state backend transitioning voucher status from ACTIVE to CLAIMED.
invariants.negative_control: Duplicate claim attempt returns HTTP 409 Conflict and Gate3AlreadyConsumedError.

invariants.statement: An authorization voucher superseded by a higher sequence number within scope cannot be consumed.
invariants.proof_requirement: CAS precondition verifying voucher sequence number equals the maximum active sequence in scope.
invariants.negative_control: Consuming superseded voucher rejected with SupersededGate3AuthorizationError.

invariants.statement: A stale runner presenting an outdated fencing token cannot mutate the latest global state head.
invariants.proof_requirement: Conditional write condition asserting fencing_token > current_committed_fencing_token.
invariants.negative_control: Stale fencing token write rejected with StaleWriterFencingError.

invariants.statement: A second genesis cannot occur while an authoritative epoch head already exists in the state backend.
invariants.proof_requirement: Genesis insertion condition asserting attribute_not_exists(epoch_id).
invariants.negative_control: Second genesis attempt raises SecondGenesisAttemptError and forces TERMINAL_HOLD.

invariants.statement: An accession admission and its corresponding denominator increment must execute within an atomic, indivisible transaction.
invariants.proof_requirement: ACID transactional write guarantees both admission row insertion and counter increment commit together.
invariants.negative_control: Simulated database write error rolls back entire transaction leaving denominator unchanged.

invariants.statement: Duplicate execution of the same logical operation following network response loss must be strictly idempotent.
invariants.proof_requirement: State backend keys transactions by deterministic idempotency key and returns existing commit without re-incrementing counter.
invariants.negative_control: Retried commit returns COMMITTED_PREVIOUSLY with zero delta to denominator.

invariants.statement: The authoritative natural denominator counter must exactly equal the count of valid admitted natural accessions.
invariants.proof_requirement: Audit check asserts stored_denominator == count(admissions where status == ADMITTED).
invariants.negative_control: Divergence between stored and derived counter triggers immediate TERMINAL_HOLD.

invariants.statement: Raw SEC evidence octets must be persisted verbatim without modification and protected by WORM Compliance Mode locks.
invariants.proof_requirement: S3/GCS Object Lock in Compliance Mode with minimum 7-year retention period active.
invariants.negative_control: Attempted DeleteObject or DeleteObjectVersion returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.

invariants.statement: An admission record cannot reference non-existent, un-anchored, or un-verified raw evidence.
invariants.proof_requirement: Atomic commit precondition asserts existence and SHA-256 match of raw evidence object in WORM storage.
invariants.negative_control: Commit referencing missing object ID rejected with MissingEvidenceObjectError.

invariants.statement: Raw evidence cannot be silently rewritten or altered; content identity is strictly self-attesting via SHA-256.
invariants.proof_requirement: Independent replay verification recalculates SHA-256 of stored bytes against custody tuple.
invariants.negative_control: Tampered byte payload triggers EvidenceTamperDetectedError and TERMINAL_HOLD.

invariants.statement: Downstream processing, parsing, or candidate classification failures must quarantine the evidence without deleting or rewriting the raw bytes.
invariants.proof_requirement: Failure records status CAPTURED_QUARANTINED while preserving raw evidence object in WORM storage.
invariants.negative_control: Quarantined record produces zero increment to natural denominator.

invariants.statement: Qualification test executions must execute in an isolated namespace and must never mutate natural production data or the natural denominator.
invariants.proof_requirement: Qualification writes restricted to partition 'QUALIFICATION'; natural denominator delta is asserted to be zero.
invariants.negative_control: Qualification execution attempting write to 'NATURAL' partition rejected by schema constraint.

invariants.statement: A fresh independent runner with zero local cache or database must be capable of forensically reconstructing the state head solely from external authorities.
invariants.proof_requirement: Run B executes in clean VM and verifies state head, Gate-3 claim, and evidence hash without prior runner disk.
invariants.negative_control: Runner failing to rehydrate external state aborts qualification with RehydrationFailedError.

invariants.statement: Under concurrent contender execution, exactly one runner may claim a voucher and commit an admission.
invariants.proof_requirement: Simultaneous runner contention test proves exactly one 200 OK and one 409 Conflict.
invariants.negative_control: Dual winner condition detected trips invariant alarm and aborts qualification.

invariants.statement: Emergency break-glass procedures may halt execution globally but may never authorize execution, edit state, or delete evidence.
invariants.proof_requirement: Break-glass implementation sets state status to TERMINAL_HOLD and has zero write paths to admission records.
invariants.negative_control: Break-glass attempt to increment denominator or mint authorization rejected.

invariants.statement: System runners must reject execution if system clock skew relative to backend clock exceeds 5000 milliseconds.
invariants.proof_requirement: Pre-commit clock check verifies |runner_time - backend_time| <= 5000ms.
invariants.negative_control: Simulated 6-second clock skew causes immediate abort with ClockSkewExceededError.

invariants.statement: Downgrade of protocol versions is strictly prohibited; runners executing older protocols cannot interact with newer state backends.
invariants.proof_requirement: State backend asserts runner_protocol_version >= backend_protocol_version.
invariants.negative_control: Outdated protocol client rejected with ProtocolVersionMismatchError.
